latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of grafana-readonly—provides read-only access to existing Grafana dashboards and panels.

- Enables searching and viewing dashboards, panels, queries, and variables without modification.
- Supports rerunning existing panel queries with new time ranges or variables.
- Explicitly prevents dashboard or panel creation, update, or deletion.
- Offers clear task and answering guidance for Grafana-first analytics workflows.
- Includes escalation guidance when read-only access is insufficient.
